messages:
maria: FYI hitting a reproducible error in the sample app for the Next.js Edge example — Cloudflare worker fails to start when we publish ESM-only builds.
oliver: ugh. what error?
maria: ReferenceError: require is not defined — stack from the edge runtime after importing the SDK via `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` in the edge handler.
samir: are we shipping only ESM in the published package? I thought we had a CJS compat layer.
maria: current package.json on main has "type": "module" and exports only point at "./dist/esm/index.js" under "import". no "require" target.
chris: that breaks Cloudflare Workers and some app setups (Next Edge, Vercel Edge) that want ESM but still bundle/respect conditional exports differently. also consumers using `const r = require('@redwood/inference')` fail in node serverless functions.
oliver: we discussed dual-pkg but left it half-baked. current build just outputs esm via tsup with `format: ['esm']`. we can add `cjs` target but need to sort types and exports mapping.
samir: Suggestion: add a small `package.json` exports map like:

```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

and keep the top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" for TS consumers.
maria: that would help, but also need to ensure our published tarball actually contains `dist/cjs`. CI currently doesn't build cjs.
chris: agree. we should also update the sample apps to import the ESM entry ergonomically for edge runtimes: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference/esm'` isn't great. exports map helps so bundlers pick the right file automatically.
oliver: watchouts: adding a CJS build increases release time and size. maybe build CJS only for releases (ci) and keep dev faster. we can add an incremental build job.
samir: types gotchas — TS "types" field points to single d.ts but when we have dual outputs the declaration paths relative to exports can confuse TS resolver in some setups. I recommend emitting a flat `dist/index.d.ts` and referencing that in package.json (no nested typesVersions).
maria: onboarding friction: a few teammates reported following the sample app and hitting a runtime error, then dropping into Google and hitting weird bundler issues. that's a bad first impression.
chris: can we add a smoke test job that runs the Next Edge sample inside the release pipeline? quick headless run that imports the package and executes a small handler.
oliver: yes — I'll add `smoke:edge` CI step that installs the tarball from `npm pack` and runs a tiny Node script + Cloudflare worker runtime shim (node-based) to assert no `require` errors.
samir: also add a short section in the README under "Edge / Serverless" with explicit examples for Next.js, Vercel, Cloudflare, and how to import the SDK depending on environment. small code snippets: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` for modern ESM, `const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference')` for CJS.
maria: one more: auth/retry behavior — sample app uses default fetch polyfill in edge and some folks saw 401s because the SDK tried to refresh token using a Node-only K/V store. we should detect runtime and avoid refresh attempt or provide clear error.
samir: file an issue for runtime detection + add a helpful error message linking to docs.
chris: ACK. I'll scope CI change + smoke test. oliver — can you do the dual-build PR? include package.json exports + types pointing to dist/index.d.ts.
oliver: on it. I'll open a PR with tsup config + package.json patch and a note to bump release notes.
maria: thanks — please tag me in the PR, this was first user-reported issue from onboarding flow. :heart:
deploy-bot: CI: smoke-edge job queued (awaiting PR).
thread_summary: Quick conversation about the JS/TS SDK publish strategy: ESM-only build breaks edge/sample apps and CJS consumers. Action items: add CJS build in CI, update exports/types mapping, add smoke-edge CI test, improve README edge onboarding, and runtime detection for auth/retry behavior.
